identity.export.title: Export personal info backup
identity.export.prompt: Exporting an encrypted personal info backup requires verifying your master password:
identity.export.failed: Failed to export personal info backup
identity.export.plainPrompt: Exporting plaintext requires verifying your master password:
identity.export.plainWarning: You are about to export {count} personal info record(s) to an UNENCRYPTED plaintext .json file, including name, ID number, card number and CVV. Anyone with access to that file can read all of it directly. This plaintext .json can be re-imported through "Import backup" (which requires verifying your master password and confirming the risk again), and can also be used to migrate to other tools. Make sure your export and storage environment is secure.
